source: WHO Weekly Epidemiological Record 1975 50(29) Cholera in 1974
processing_notes: Source states: 'Table 1. Cases of Cholera Notified to WHO, 1974 - AFRICA - ... Niger 286; Nigeria 776; South Africa 37 ... TOTAL 7 877' - interpreted as 776 sCh cases. CLOSES THE 1974 HISTORICAL GAP. WHO Weekly Epidemiological Record No.29, 18 July 1975, pp.261-262. Nigeria is absent from WHO's modern Global Health Observatory annual cholera series for 1974 (the series runs 1970-73, 1975-89, 1991-2016), which is why the MOSAIC baseline has a 1974 hole; the figure does exist in the primary WER record. TABLE-ALIGNMENT VERIFICATION: the PDF text layer collapses the two-column table, so the 19 Africa country names and 19 numbers were re-aligned positionally and checked two ways - (a) the 19 values sum to exactly 7877, the printed Africa total, and (b) 11 of the 17 values checkable against WHO GHO match that source exactly, including the values immediately either side of Nigeria (Niger 286 and South Africa 37), so position 14 = Nigeria = 776 is secure. Deaths not given: WER 1974 Table 1 reports cases only, Table 2 is a global 1970-74 summary with no country deaths. WER footnote states '1974: provisional figures'. Suspected/notified cases, national total.
